project.visitorDecision: Choose up to three source-reviewed waterfall locations worth investigating by U.P. region, intended travel date and upper-end on-site time budget without implying any real-time opening.
project.primaryAction: Select a candidate to focus its waterfall map pin and inspect the primary public parking and trail authority before travel.

claims.subject: route-guidance
claims.limitation: Only M-107 at Whitetail and the specified South Boundary Road segment close December 1–late spring; this does not imply every waterfall or park road closes.

claims.subject: parking-rule
claims.limitation: Usual seasonal vehicle access is not a live gate state or permission to bypass a posted closure.

claims.subject: parking-rule
claims.limitation: Most roadside parks announced closed for the season; exact status at Fumee, Agate or Tioga needs confirmation.

claims.subject: park-access
claims.accessScope: Named Black River Scenic Byway waterfall trails and platforms, not entire forest or river
claims.limitation: Location-specific construction notice; future work or reopening is not proved by absence of another update.

claims.subject: park-access
claims.accessScope: Munising Falls trail past visitor-center lot, not the visitor center itself
claims.limitation: NPS reports trail closed until further notice; lot/visitor center access does not make the waterfall overlook reachable.

claims.subject: park-access
claims.limitation: No comprehensive official API for all 72 trails, plowed roads and parking; no green open-now status may be generated.

claims.subject: river-flow
claims.limitation: USGS station proximity is not waterfall-specific discharge or a safe walking access report; no live water claims are made.

decisionState.selectedIdField: HTML data-id identifying a curated waterfall source record
decisionState.sourceOfTruth: The existing 72 data-fall cards, their high-end published time range, recorded status and cautious official date-specific guidance in public/assets/up-waterfalls-visit-lens.js.
decisionState.unavailableBehavior: Retain HTML waterfall profiles and source links when JS, map tiles, legal parking, full time range or fresh official updates are unavailable; never invent open status.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Show three geographically separate research candidates with full on-site range at or under 60 minutes, not a one-day itinerary.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No source certifies today's access; no driving distances computed.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Show Wagner Falls as a short source-backed stop and exclude 90-to-150-minute Chapel Falls and closed Munising Falls.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Upper-end time threshold and NPS trail closure remain visible.

scenarios.input: Search Bond, select winter date, switch to Rainbow, then Bond
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Restore Bond visit notes and selection; map focus and saved stop use one waterfall ID.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Bond road is outside usual vehicle season, not automatically open or permanently closed.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Show original full 72 fall cards, source links and clear static date/time feature fallback.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No dynamic status or route is claimed without client JavaScript.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Keep rendered sourced waterfall list, visitor guide links and official parking source.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Missing map does not authorize waterfall pin driving directions.

scenarios.input: Choose summer 2028 and select a candidate
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Identify that selected date is beyond the current source research window and give only historical access guidance.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Source age is explicit; no old opening presented as current.

scenarios.input: 30-minute budget for a destination without a parseable upper time
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Exclude unsupported time claims from a bounded visit recommendation.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: An unknown duration never silently becomes a quick stop.

failures.no-js: All static cards, their links and the no-JavaScript explanatory line remain useful without client calculation.
failures.no-tiles: Keep text candidates, field guides and original access-source links; do not draw invented routes or parking positions.
failures.no-image: The new desk deliberately has no image; it remains usable with all existing images blocked or unavailable.
failures.stale-data: Warn dates beyond spring 2027 as historical, retain conservative source-check links and never infer open-now from a stored seasonal rule.

qa.scopeNote: Not yet measured. Real Chromium and GitHub exact-head checks are required, including map tiles, chosen date, 30-minute exclusion and source warnings.
